calendar.note: 20200502/20200503 are already weekends; the fictional holiday block is index 0-based, computed by generate.py, never hand-guessed.

forward_return_labels.description: ret_o2o_h at T=index15 for h in {1,5,10,20}; entry=open[T+1], planned exit=open[T+1+h]. Every stock's price is piecewise-constant (see README), so most returns are exactly 0% by construction; the point of each case is the exception flag, not the return magnitude.

SA002.SZ.note: identical to SA001.SZ at every date; rank-tie partner

SA003.SZ.note: full-day suspension at index16 (the T+1 entry day itself) -> entry impossible for any h

SA004.SZ.note: index16 open==high==low==close==104.5==up_limit (one-word board); label computed normally, flag records the entry condition

h10.note: exit day index26 itself has a quote (resumption already happened at index23); no delay for this h

beyond_data_end.description: T_END=index45; entry=index46 (T_END+1), exit=index(46+h). This is a calendar-driven rule, identical for every stock in the cross-section; SA001.SZ is given as one concrete worked example, but it applies equally to SA002/03/04/05/07/08 still listed at index46 (SA006 already delisted, absent from this cross-section entirely, not a 'beyond_data_end' case).

benchmark.description: Step 4 self-built benchmark returns for the 000300.SH member subsample (daily_index_member, available from 20200309 = index5 with the 5-trading-day publication lag), plus the official-index calibration. Members at T, ret_1d at T+1; index16 is the ONLY non-zero self-built return in the fixture because SA004 jumps 95 -> 104.5 there with quotes on both days (ret_1d = 104.5/95-1 = 0.1 exactly).

self_built_at_index16.equal_weight_formula: (0 + 0 + 0.1)/3 = 1/30; SA003.SZ ret_1d is NULL (suspended at index16) and is excluded from the mean, NOT counted as 0
self_built_at_index16.circ_mv_weight_formula: 0.1*665000/(1000000+800000+665000) = 66500/2465000 = 133/4930; weights are circ_mv at member_date index15 (SA001=100*10000, SA002=100*8000, SA004=95*7000); SA003's circ_mv is excluded from the denominator because its ret_1d is NULL
self_built_at_index16.flat_day_note: at index17 SA003 still has ret_1d NULL (prev quote index15 != prev_trade_date index16), so return_count is again 3 and both benchmark returns are 0

calibration_000300.description: Official index_daily.csv covers exactly index15..18 (20200323..20200326) with closes 1000/1100/1100/1100 and pre_closes 1000/1000/1100/1100, so official returns are [0, 0.1, 0, 0]. Self-built equal-weight returns on the same dates are [0, 1/30, 0, 0] = official/3 exactly, hence Pearson == 1.

factors.description: Step 5 baseline factor expectations. Values are hand-computed from the fixture's closed-form data (adj_factor=1, total_mv in 万元 x 10000 -> CNY, amount x 1000 -> CNY). Absent lists mean NO factor_value row may exist (insufficient history / missing inputs), not a NULL row: only non-NULL values are published.

formulas.ep_ttm: TTM net income 500000000 / 1e10 (Q4-2019 original visible at T)

SA001_at_T.absent_reason: T=index15 has fewer than 20 quoted days of history (rolling windows) and far fewer than the 126/252 trading-day momentum lookbacks.

formulas.ep_ttm: 520000000 / 1e10 once the same-day revision becomes visible at T+1
formulas.np_yoy_q: (520M-275M)=245M single-quarter Q4-2019 / 180M - 1 = 0.36111...; revenue is unrevised so rev_yoy_q stays 1.0

formulas.vol_20: window index16..35 has one ret_1d=0.1 and nineteen 0: mean 0.005, ddof=0 variance 0.01/20-0.005^2 = 0.000475, std = sqrt(0.000475)
formulas.amihud_20: only index16 contributes: |0.1|/(10450*1000) averaged over 20 days = 0.1/(10450*1000*20)

SA003_at_index35_absent.reason: SA003 has no quote at index16 and index35 inside the 20-day window: only 18 quoted days (17 non-null ret_1d after the resumption-day NULL), below min_periods=20. Suspended days must NOT be silently compressed out of the window.

SA001_at_index65.reason: 66 fixture days can never satisfy the 126/252-day momentum lookbacks, even at the last date.

vendor_comparison.description: pe_ttm=25.0 and pb=2.0 are constant for every fixture quote row. SA001's self-built ep_ttm at T is 0.05 vs vendor 1/25=0.04 (relative deviation 0.25 > 0.05 large-deviation threshold); bp 0.5 vs 1/2=0.5 (deviation 0).

industry_pit.description: Raw observable in_date/out_date facts from index_member_all.csv; exact Stage 2 PIT-status enum naming is decided in Step 2, not asserted here.

SA007.SZ.note: in_date (index30) falls strictly inside the fixture calendar (index0..65); at T=index15 (< in_date) SA007 has not yet joined this sector under the conservative 'snapshot applies from in_date onward' rule; from index30 onward it is a member

SA008.SZ.note: in_date precedes the fixture's first trading date (index0=20200302); SA008 is already a member on every fixture date

market_cap_unit_conversion.description: total_mv (and circ_mv) in stk_factor_pro.csv must equal close (CNY yuan) * total_share (10k shares) exactly, i.e. total_mv/circ_mv are in 10k-CNY units. Checked at T=index15 for every stock.

financial_pit.description: SA001.SZ only. available_date = first trading date strictly greater than ann_date (core.financial.available). Cumulative totals follow the 10/25/55/100% shape of each field's full-year value documented in README.md.

q4_revision.note: same end_date as q4_original; ann_date == T itself, so NOT visible at T (strict >), visible from T+1 onward

at_T_index15.note: q4_revision not yet visible (ann_date==T is excluded by the strict-greater-than rule)

before_Q4_index14_or_earlier.note: insufficient trailing quarters (no prior-fiscal-year Q4 in this fixture); Stage 1's own TTM-insufficient-history rule applies, not re-tested here

insufficient_cross_section.description: At THIN_DAY=index35, SA003.SZ (suspended that day) and SA006.SZ (delisted since index20) both have no quote; the other 6 stocks do. With a test-overridden min_cross_section_count=7 (real config default is 300, irrelevant at this fixture's scale), 6 < 7 so this date must be excluded from any cross-sectional statistic and logged with its actual count.

evaluation_formula_fixture.description: Independent, fully hand/calculator-computed numeric examples pinned to the exact formulas frozen in configs/factor_research.yaml. Not registered Step 5 factors; not a substitute for Step 7's real panel-based tests.

ic_rank_ic_with_ties.description: Toy 'mock factor' = close price at T=index15 for all 8 stocks, paired with ret_o2o_5 (h=5 forward return) at T. SA003.SZ excluded: entry_blocked -> null label, standard practice to drop null pairs before computing IC.
ic_rank_ic_with_ties.note: RankIC is exactly 0 here: 6 of 7 ret5 values tie at rank 3.5 (all zero returns), only SA005.SZ differs. This is intentionally a near-degenerate case chosen to exercise tie handling, not to illustrate predictive power.

winsorize_standardize_on_8_stock_panel.description: Winsorize+standardize applied to the raw 8-value factor panel at T (all 8 stocks, including SA003.SZ which is still a valid factor observation even though its label is null).
winsorize_standardize_on_8_stock_panel.note_SA008: 400 > upper bound 140.0 -> capped to 140.0; this is the fixture's deliberate winsorize-outlier case

neutralize_log_circ_mv_properties.description: Partial neutralization (log_circ_mv only; industry_dummy deferred to Step 6). Checked by OLS orthogonality property, not exact residual values, since circ_mv's natural log is not a hand-verifiable round number.

group_performance_standalone_series.description: Standalone 4-period return series, independent of the 8-stock entity panel (that panel's returns are too degenerate -- mostly flat -- for a useful Sharpe/drawdown illustration). periods_per_year = annualization_days / h = 252/20 = 12.6, matching an h=20 non-overlapping quantile regime.
